name: skylark_get_gate
intent: Find the departure gate for a SkyLark flight
description: Opens My Trips in SkyLark, selects the trip matching the requested city, and reads the departure gate from the trip details.
patterns: What gate does my flight leave from
Find the gate for my flight

inputs.name: trip_city
inputs.description: The city of the trip whose gate is requested.

steps.intent: Open My Trips to find the {{trip_city}} flight
Open the {{trip_city}} flight to read its gate
